rules.message: Each editable row is its own record tbody (class hc-datagrid__record) — the atomic swap unit for row + error row.
Persisting a cell edit is a mutation of one resource — data-hx-patch on the record tbody.
The record re-render replaces the whole tbody: data-hx-swap="outerHTML".
Put the trigger on the record tbody itself — it hears only its own descendants' bubbled hc:datagridedit, so scoping is free (a grid-level listener would persist every row through one URL).
Opt the grid into the saving state: data-hc-datagrid-pending on .hc-datagrid (the re-render contract clears it).
